title: Allow users to delete their entire account (not just the profile)
body: It would make a lot of sense if there was a way (like an option in the admin panel) to allow users to delete all their messages and the entire account (the way admins currently are able to do this). It would also be required by the GDPR as far as I know.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
> It would also be required by the GDPR as far as I know.

Contacting an administrator for account deletion satisfies the Right to be Forgotten portion of GDPR.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: We currently do not allow this because context is an important part of discussions, and so we feel that an administrator must do the act of deletion that removes all content for a user.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @julianlam Tho it's pretty annoying if you ask me.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
> @julianlam Tho it's pretty annoying if you ask me.

How frequently has this happened so far?

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @pauljherring about 20-30 times. Our forum has around 2000 members. But not all at the same time, but rather every 2-3 days which is - as I said - pretty annoying.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: If you're getting that many people actively demanding that you delete their accounts, it sounds like you need more tools (or help with existing ones) to vet people coming onto the forum to begin with - deleting the accounts appears to be solving a symptom of something, rather than dealing with some underlying problem.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
@pauljherring It's a political forum where people are upset very quickly. Additionally, we have many tin foil hat users that want to delete their entire accounts after trying out the forum.

But ok fine. I'll leave this closed then.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
